To organize a viewing or to place a bid on this property go to www.teamlorraine.ie or scan the QR code on the photograph section of this brochure.


 Circle of Legends` & Award-Winning International RE/MAX Agent for over 22 years, Team Lorraine Mulligan of RE/MAX Results is proud to present No. 116 Oldtown Woods, a superb one-bedroom first-floor apartment in pristine, turn-key condition.

Built just three years ago and boasting an impressive A2 BER rating, this stylish home offers exceptional energy efficiency combined with contemporary comfort. The current owner`s tech-savvy and climate-conscious upgrades include blackout thermal blinds in the living area, maximising heat retention and further enhancing efficiency throughout the apartment. 

Flooded with natural light, the apartment enjoys a dual-aspect layout and high ceilings in the living space, creating a bright, airy atmosphere and a wonderful sense of space. Finished in a modern, tasteful décor, every square foot has been thoughtfully designed and exceptionally well maintained. An added and rare benefit is the low-density layout, with just two apartments per block, offering a level of privacy seldom found in apartment living.

Externally, the property benefits from private designated parking to the rear, along with ample visitor parking.

Located in the heart of the ever-popular Oldtown Woods development, No. 116 perfectly blends stylish suburban living with everyday convenience. This move-in-ready home is ideal for first-time buyers, investors, or those looking to downsize without compromising on quality or location. Oldtown Woods is a modern, meticulously planned development known for its strong community spirit and high energy standards.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a bright, modern, and beautifully presented apartment in one of Celbridge`s most sought-after developments. No. 116 Oldtown Woods truly offers style, comfort, and convenience in equal measure.

LOCAL AREA
116 Oldtown Woods is located in the modern and attractive Oldtown Woods development, just west of Celbridge village, it offers a mix of 2, 3 and 4 bed homes (and some duplexes/apartments), with excellent energy efficiency standards (many A rated homes)
The neighbourhood combines contemporary living with a strong sense of community. Landscaped communal lawns, green open spaces, and modern finishes contribute to a comfortable, family friendly environment. 
The location is very convenient about 5 minutes` drive from Celbridge village, where there are shops, cafés, restaurants and all the everyday local services. 

TRANSPORT & CONNECTIVITY
Road Networks:
• Oldtown Woods has easy access to the M4 motorway via the Celbridge interchange, which connects directly towards Dublin. 
• Also accessible are the M50 and other regional roads which provide broader connectivity around Dublin and to other continue.
Public Transport:
• Nearby bus services include the Dublin Bus C4 and 27X, which go toward Merrion Square/Dublin, as well as Bus Éireann route 115/120 to Connolly Station. 
• There is a feeder bus from Celbridge village to Hazelhatch & Celbridge train station. 
Train Services:
• Hazelhatch & Celbridge station offers regular commuter rail services into Dublin City Centre. 
Dublin Airport:
• The development is around 25 30 mins drive from Dublin Airport via the M4 / connecting motorways. 

SHOPPING & RETAIL
• Celbridge village provides a selection of everyday shops, boutiques, cafés, restaurants and local services. 
• For larger retail and leisure, Liffey Valley Shopping Centre is accessible within about 20 minutes` drive, offering major high street stores, cinemas, etc
• Other nearby retail parks and larger stores around Leixlip, Lucan, Maynooth etc. are also reachable via short drives. (Supermarket options like Tesco, Lidl. are available in Celbridge.)

EDUCATION
Oldtown Woods is well served by educational institutions at all levels.

Primary Schools:
• Scoil Na Mainistreach. 
• North Kildare Educate Together is also within walking distance. 
• Other primary options: Aghards National School, Primrose Hill., are all conveniently nearby
Secondary Schools:
• St. Wolstan`s Community School.
• Celbridge Community School .


HEALTHCARE
• Local medical services in Celbridge include GP practices, dental clinics, pharmacies specific practices are available in the village.
• Hospitals likely to be used include Naas General Hospital, Connolly Hospital in Blanchardstown, and others for more specialised care.

RECREATION & GREEN SPACES
• Oldtown Woods includes well planned open spaces, communal lawns and landscaping. 
• Castletown House & Parklands is nearby, providing large parklands, walks, gardens, scenic outdoors. 
• Other outdoor amenities include river walks, parks and athletic / sports clubs around Celbridge. 

EMPLOYMENT HUBS / SUMMARY
• Good for commuters: direct motorway access plus train + bus links means reasonable travel into Dublin city centre and surrounding business districts. 
• Oldtown Woods offers a rare chance to own a modern, efficient 3 bed (or similar) home in a high-standard development, in a location that combines suburban calm with convenience.
